verdict_reason: The three fields the ticket names are converted correctly and match the existing call-site pattern, but the fourth country field on the same page (transhipmentDestinationCountry) stays a plain select while its shared item list loses the divider.

todos.issue: transhipmentDestinationCountry is left as a plain govukSelect while transitDestinationCountry, the same 'Destination country' question fed by the same countryItems on the same page, becomes appAccessibleAutocomplete; this PR's controller change also drops DIVIDER_OPTION from the shared countryItems() on the grounds that the lists 'feed type-aheads', so the one remaining scroll-only select loses its divider and the controller comment is untrue for it. The ticket names only three fields, so this may be a deliberate scope limit, but the user story says 'wherever the journey asks for a country or a port'.
todos.fix: Convert transhipmentDestinationCountry to appAccessibleAutocomplete with autocomplete: { showAllValues: true, noResults: copy.country.noResults } (then drop the unused govukSelect import and update the transhipment fit test to the input/-select pair), or confirm with the ticket owner that it is out of scope and correct the controller comment.
